title: Telomere Maintenance and Gene Amplification in Saccharomyces Cerevisiae
summary: This cluster revolves around the maintenance of telomeres and gene amplification in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. Telomere, a method or tool, is involved in mmBIR and has sequence homology with chr II. SUL1, a gene or protein, is amplified by Rad52, pol32, and yku70, and is involved in Gene amplification. The SUL1 locus, located on chr II, contains the URA3 gene and is a probe for CEN2. Telomerase, a gene or protein, is involved in the replication of ITS. The Saccharomyces Genome Database, a method or tool, has phenotypic characteristics of SGD. The organisms BY4741 and FY4 are related, and Brewer Bonita J. conceptualized telomeric amplicons.
